channel.title: Our Team on Location Sound Collective
channel.description: Recent content in Our Team on Location Sound Collective

item.title: Edouard Puhl
item.author: info@lsc.com (Aurel)
item.description: Eduardo is a multi-discipline sound engineer whose work spans live stages, broadcast trucks, music-video sets, and scripted productions. From detailed Pro Tools operation to location sound for TV and film, he brings technical precision, creative sensitivity, and a flexible, solutions-driven mindset to every project.

item.title: Nick Gladwin
item.author: info@lsc.com (Aurel)
item.description:
• Nick is a studio-trained sound engineer with nearly 20 years experience working in audio. Starting out as live sound engineer, he has worked across multiple London venues and travelled the world aboard cruise ships as the head technician before settling back in London and discovering his passion for sound in film and television.
  • As a Boom Operator he has worked on high-end TV dramas and feature films, where he was lucky enough to be part of the sound teams behind the Emmy-nominated 3 Body Problem and the BAFTA-winning A Very British Scandal. These days as a Sound recordist and Quilified Drone Operator you’ll find Nick working on reality TV shows, documentaries, and short-form projects.

item.title: Rich Morgan
item.author: info@lsc.com (Aurel)
item.description:
Rich is a London based PSC sound recordist with many years of experience across TV, Feature Films, High-End TV Dramas, TVCs, Branded Content, Documentary, Corporate shoots, and BAFTA nominated short films. He delivers reliable, in sync, high quality audio in all circumstances and has a proven track record working confidently in demanding environments.

Rich has mixed everything from sports content to Tesco Christmas TVCs, and recently contributed to the Emmy award winning Masters of the Air, carrying out extensive vehicle recording work for the series.

item.title: Steve Llewellyn
item.author: info@lsc.com (Aurel)
item.description:
• With a passion for high quality sound, recordist and mixer Steven Llewellyn has a track record for executing pristine, broadcast quality audio, working on award winning programmes across the globe.

  • Offering a full audio workflow, from capturing high fidelity location sound to delivering audio post production services including Podcasts, Surround Sound, ADR, SFX, Music and Sound Design.

item.title: William Langdale
item.author: info@lsc.com (Aurel)
item.description:
Write a compelling biography that tells your story. Focus on:

  • How you got into sound recording
  • Your approach to capturing audio
  • What drives your passion for sound
  • Your working style and philosophy
  • Any unique experiences or perspectives

This content appears on your CV page and gives readers insight into who you are as a professional.

Keep it conversational but professional, ideally 3-5 paragraphs.
